title: Registration Services: roadmap, holds and deadlines (USC Registrar)
text:
Paraphrased from the official page by hand (Nov 2026).

Q: Where do I find my registration appointment time, and why might Web Registration be blocked?
A: Appointment times and permit-to-register info are in Experience USC. If an activity restriction (hold) is on your account, Web Registration stays locked until the department that placed it releases it.

Q: How do I get into a class whose section number ends in D?
A: D sections are restricted by the offering department and require D-clearance before you can register. Email or visit that department, not the Registrar.

Q: What are the official steps to register for classes at USC?
A: 1) Check appointment in Experience USC, 2) confirm address, 3) meet advisor, 4) request D-clearance/prereq waivers, 5) clear restrictions, 6) register in Web Registration, 7) get USCard/parking.

Q: Which holds stop registration, and who clears them?
A: Advisement, academic integrity, admission, ALI, community expectations, collections, housing, immunization, international, LOA, library, prevention education, probation, registrar, student life, financial services, writing program. Clear with the owning office before your appointment.

Q: Can I still register after the semester starts?
A: Yes, but registration is not permitted after the third week of classes.

Q: I am a returning student or was on a leave of absence. How do I get a registration time?
A: Contact the Registrar for a returning-student appointment. If you had an LOA, the appointment is assigned automatically once the LOA hold is lifted.

Q: Do new undergraduates register on their own, or during orientation?
A: New undergraduates register during Welcome Trojans Orientation; watch USC email for the Orientation Programs invitation.

Q: What is the minimum unit load for international students?
A: 12 units for undergraduates, 8 for master's, 6 for doctoral students and TAs; OIS clearance is needed to drop below full time.
